correctness.rationale: The drifted resolvent at r is G_r(y|x)=q^(-1)exp((mu(y-x)-q|y-x|)/(2D)); solving the two-sink rank-two system gives the exact B(k) with denominator 1+K/q+(1-c^2)k(K-k)/q^2>0. Renewal gives T=(1-B)/(rB). Local-time Laplace functional yields B(k)=-r integral exp(-rt) E[(L_+-L_-)^2 exp(-kL_+-(K-k)L_-)]dt<0, strict because paths hit only one site with positive probability. Endpoint derivative has sign (z-1)+[c(z+1)-2]K/q-(1-c)(1-cz)(K/q)^2 with negative derivative on K>=0, so one Kc. Symmetry comparison rules out upstream preference; endpoint and interior classification follows for each K, with c z<1 from q>mu. Numerically independently checked D=mu=a=r=1 threshold Kc~1.8149905664 and interior k/K~.74285 at 4Kc; finite-grid check supplements analytic proof.
